It's time for Jujutsu Kaisen Season 3 and you know what that means! It means I get to explode in joy as Yuji, Megumi, Choso and Yuta pick up the pieces following the Shibuya Incident. This time navigating an entire season without Gojo all the while Kenjaku is building something sinister. The Culling Game! What did I think? Well... here are my first impressionsm, thoughts on and review for.. Jujutsu Kaisen Season 3: The Culling Games. 

COVERS USED:

Yuta VS Kurourushi (Melodic Blaze)
Aizo (JonatanKing)
Seinfield Theme (Anna Sentina)
The Lonely Shepherd (Alison Sparrow)
Battle Without Honor or Humanity (Artur Atroshchenko)

Yuji VS Hiruguma (Diego Mitre Music)

title: JUJUTSU KAISEN: Culling Game - Blind Review
